- Register: "Marques Electronic Technology (Ningo) Co., Ltd."
- Document: "Marques Electronic Technology (Ningbo) Co., Ltd."

The difference is "Ningo" vs "Ningbo". Ningbo is a real city in China (Zhejiang province). "Ningo" is a common typo/OCR miss of "Ningbo" (missing the 'b'). This is clearly spelling drift — the same company. The document is the legal instrument, and "Ningbo" is the correct city name. So verdict: same-entity, best_value should be the document's "Marques Electronic Technology (Ningbo) Co., Ltd." since it's the correct spelling.

The rules say: spelling drift, legal-suffix drift, accent differences = same-entity. For best_value in same-entity case... The rules don't explicitly say which value for same-entity spelling drift, but generally the document is the legal instrument and "Ningbo" is the correct spelling of the city, so best_value = document's value.

Verdict: same-entity, best_value: "Marques Electronic Technology (Ningbo) Co., Ltd."
